_doc: Follow-up to 2026-10-09b: the Mount Abu post still quoted the formula taxi and said every category halves off-peak. Taxi is calibrated and flat across seasons (087); only hotels halve.

fixes.old: A full-day taxi runs ₹4,800. Off-peak (May-August), the same categories drop by roughly half.
fixes.new: A full-day taxi runs about ₹2,100 in any season. Off-peak (May-August), hotel prices drop by roughly half.
